name: Lord & Taylor

prices.note: Like-for-like item: women's jeans. Whole Jeans & Denim collection from the public Shopify endpoint /collections/jeans-denim/products.json (11 pages, 2,662 products); 189 excluded as sale (compare_at above price, or tagged Final Sale), leaving 2,473 regular-price items from 201 labels (most: Gucci, Mother, Haikure, AGOLDE, Balenciaga). Lowest: Sunflower Wide Twist Jeans $234.90; highest: Ermanno Scervino Wide-Leg Crystal Jeans $3,165.90. Median $605.90. The collection is under Clothing (Mens is a separate nav item); 2 titles mention men.

notes: Homepage: nav Designers, Heritage Collection, Clothing, Handbags, Accessories, Jewelry, Shoes, Mens, Home, Pre-Loved, Clearance; 'Crafting trends for over 200 years, Lord & Taylor is where legacy meets luxury'; banners 'FREE SHIPPING OVER $300', 'ALL PRICES INCLUDE IMPORT DUTIES'.
About page: founded 1826 in Lower Manhattan; in 2020 it closed its physical stores and moved to 'a fully digital model'. Current owner not stated.

Shipping & returns page: ships to the 48 contiguous United States only, no international shipping, no APO/FPO or PO boxes; many vendor partners, 'including most luxury items, ship directly from locations outside the United States'; $10 flat rate under $300. Returns within 14 days of purchase; $24 return label fee deducted; 12% International Return Processing Fee on items shipped from outside the US; duties non-refundable.
Store runs on Shopify; product tags show partner-feed sources (e.g. link2lux, dresscode).
